verdicts.flaw_description: A named alternative cause reaches every unit: "The lubricant supply moved from mineral to synthetic grade mid-cycle, and every machine here drew from that supply." Synthetic grease extends bearing life on its own, so the 260-410 extra hours cannot be attributed to the redesigned bearing.

The measured area and the treated area do not match: "Yields cover every hectare in each block fitted with the line" while "the line watered about a quarter of each block's hectares intermittently." Roughly three-quarters of the hectares producing the 0.4-0.7 t/ha gain were never watered by the drip line, so the block-wide rise cannot be attributed to it.

Two of the four cases have dates running backwards: the tomato was "fed 3 August" but measured "by 20 June", and the oak was "fed 2 May" but measured "by 19 April". The height gain is recorded before the fertilizer was applied.

A competing cause covers every cohort: "The free trial ran eighteen days, up from ten in the earlier period, and every cohort here signed up on that trial." Nearly doubling the trial length mechanically lifts week-two retention, so the 3-6 point gain is not attributable to the onboarding email.

The score population and the treated population diverge: "Scores cover every pupil on each class roll, and a quarter of each roll missed at least one program session." The 5-9 point gain is measured over pupils a quarter of whom did not receive the full program, so the figures do not isolate the program's effect.

The timings cover a narrower, self-selected population than the claim: "Timings cover the runs that stayed on the issued route, and about a sixth of each depot's runs left the issued route." The excluded sixth are exactly the deviating runs most likely to be slow, so the 5-9 minute improvement is measured only on the compliant subset.
